s-09-2-failure.alt: Failure case: do not publish. The 48 pixel pillar row on Newsprint with Track’s icon in red and no word underlined, so only the red says which pillar is current.
s-09-2-failure.notes: Color alone marks the current pillar (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1). Failure band per D2-308.

s-09-3-correct.alt: The four pillar icons at true size at 16, 24, 48 and 96 pixels, one row per pillar with its word first: Explain, Track, Connect and Act, every icon in one color. At 16 and 24 pixels each is a pixel fit, a 1 pixel line drawn on whole pixels. Below, Track’s 16 and 24 pixel fits as a standard screen draws them, enlarged four times, every pixel full or empty.
s-09-3-correct.notes: DR-133, DR-179, D2-634, D2-808. From the sprite: the 16 px fit, the 24 px pattern (the fit under 2x, the master from 2x) and the master at 48 and 96 px, one color. The enlarged views are PNG renders at 1x of the fit files in pillar-icons/svg/, scaled four times in square pixels; each plate's word sits in the first column, so every icon under 48 px keeps its word beside it (R9). Marks at true size are graphics, so the 13 px floor applies to the words only.

s-09-3-failure.alt: Failure case: Track’s master scaled to 16 pixels beside the word Track, next to the 16 pixel fit beside the same word, at true size and enlarged four times. Scaled down, the master’s lines fall under a pixel and draw gray, and the magnifier’s lens and the route’s turns blur together; the fit draws each line as one full pixel.
s-09-3-failure.notes: The master (civic-line-v6/black) at 16 px from the sprite, as a producer would drag it into a menu, beside the fit. The enlarged views are PNG renders at 1x, scaled four times in square pixels.

s-09-4-correct.alt: Two pieces at true size, both Illustrative. First, Track’s section opener: a Charcoal panel with Track’s icon at 128 pixels in Newsprint lines with its red map pin and magnifier handle, then the word Track, the line Watch the vote. in large heavy type, and Track’s job: Follow the decision and keep its record within reach. Second, a card that leads to Track’s section: Track’s icon on a rounded Charcoal tile at 76 pixels, in Newsprint and red, beside the word Track and the same job line.
s-09-4-correct.notes: DR-112, DR-138, R11, R13, D2-42. The opener follows Board 6's: a Charcoal panel, as the guide's part openers are, with the master at 128 px from the sprite in the Newsprint ink and its accent token, standalone, so signature red. Watch the vote. is the line our fifth edition set on its pillar plate. The tile is the Civic Line package's rounded two-color Charcoal tile (civic-line/tiles/rounded-charcoal/svg, the file the set in use points to, D2-716) at its 76 px minimum (D2-42), placed as an image. The job line is chapter 01's, word for word.

s-09-4-failure.alt: Failure case: do not publish. An Illustrative report card whose kicker opens with Track’s pillar icon at 24 pixels, then the label Report and the topic State legislatures, over the headline How state committees record their votes.
s-09-4-failure.notes: DR-112: a kicker keeps its content label and words, and a pillar icon never enters it (Rule 01.21). The icon is drawn as a 24 px pillar icon should be, and the kicker's words follow Rule 01.21's type, so the only fault is where the icon stands. The card is a phone's 328 px column in a 360 px plate (CA-S5). The headline is chapter 01's invented Report example. Failure band per D2-308.

s-12-divider-correct.alt: An Illustrative article on a town budget at true size, in three sections: Who writes the budget, then a 1 pixel Stone hairline, Who changes it, then the hinge divider, a line broken by a small Charcoal ampersand, and What you can do. Below, the hairline on Newsprint, White and Charcoal in Stone, and on Prussian in White.
s-12-divider-correct.notes: The hairline is a 1 px top border in oa.color.border.hairline on each surface (Stone; White on Prussian), with 24 px (oa.space.300) above and below. The hinge divider is chapter 04's, drawn by stage_a_identity_s04.divider (Rule 04.4, DR-96). The article is invented. From our fifth edition's Stone hairline dividers and its standard Hairlines, not boxes.

s-12-divider-failure.alt: Failure case: do not publish. The same Illustrative article with dashed lines between its sections, and no hinge divider before What you can do.
s-12-divider-failure.notes: D1-21: no brand graphic uses a dotted or dashed line, since the atlas's key gives them to evidence grades. Failure band per D2-308.

s-12-index.alt: Every graphic device in this guide, the job it does and the rule that sets it.
s-12-index.notes: The device index the architecture map asks for (the hinge divider is listed here and set in Rule 04.4). readable: the table and its links reach assistive technology. Rules 12.5 to 12.9 are the systems designer's (D2-829).

s-12-watermark-correct.alt: Two Illustrative pages at true size. A report page on Newsprint headed Research brief, The decision behind the service., with a paragraph at left, and a very large ampersand B in Charcoal at 8 percent in the open right margin, running off the page’s right edge, which cuts through its loop and its crossing stroke. A section opener on Charcoal headed Track, Follow the decision and keep its record within reach., with the same B in Newsprint at 10 percent in its right margin. Neither watermark sits behind any words.
s-12-watermark-correct.notes: B's display master (ampersand/20261028_Amp-B-Display-Master.svg) at 320 px tall, in Charcoal with opacity oa.opacity.watermarkOnLight (0.08, 1.17 to 1) and in Newsprint with oa.opacity.watermarkOnDark (0.10, 1.24 to 1), the two opacities our fifth edition's quiet signatures used, now tokens (Rule 05.6). B's top 20 px under the page's top, and the page's right edge cutting B at 50 of its 93.29 units: through the loop, the crossing stroke and the lower counter, left of the arm, so no piece of B stands alone at the edge (round 3, CD-S10, CA-S10). The report page's heading is our fifth edition's watermark mockup's (architecture map, V5 03); the opener's line is Track's job line, as chapter 01 and Rule 09.4 print it; the paragraphs are invented.

s-12-watermark-failure.alt: Failure case: do not publish. The Illustrative report page with the large Charcoal B at 8 percent moved behind its heading and paragraph, so its edges cross the letters.
s-12-watermark-failure.notes: Our fifth edition's rule: a watermark belongs in an open margin, never behind text. Failure band per D2-308.

s-12-signature-correct.alt: Two Illustrative pieces at true size. A report’s running head on White: the L8 monogram, O & A with a red ampersand, 48 pixels wide and opaque, then Report 3, How state committees record their votes, and the page number 7. Then a still from an explainer video, 480 by 270 pixels on Charcoal: a bill’s six numbered steps with the fourth current, the words Step 4 of 6: First chamber, and L8 in Newsprint with its red ampersand, 48 pixels wide, in the top right corner.
s-12-signature-correct.notes: L8 (lockups/20261028_L8-Monogram-Master.svg) at its 48 px minimum (Rule 03.4), in Rule 03.5's colors: Charcoal with signature red on White, Newsprint with signature red on Charcoal. Our fifth edition's quiet signatures sent small headers and video corners to an opaque compact signature; L8 is the one monogram (D2-193). The steps are chapter 11's at 360 px (S.99002's states), on Charcoal. The report title is chapter 01's invented Report example.

s-12-signature-failure.alt: Failure case: do not publish. The same Illustrative video still with L8 in the corner at 10 percent opacity, as a watermark would be, so the mark almost vanishes.
s-12-signature-failure.notes: A watermark shrunk to a corner: L8 at 48 px in Newsprint at oa.opacity.watermarkOnDark. Failure band per D2-308.

s-12-pattern-correct.alt: An Illustrative report cover at true size on Newsprint, 360 by 466 pixels, with the kicker Report 3, the title How state committees record their votes and a short paragraph at the top. Stone arcs 1 pixel wide spread from the bottom right corner across the open lower part of the cover, and stop well short of the words.
s-12-pattern-correct.notes: Built from the hinge devices, after icon study 07's ring rhythm. Hinge arcs: circles from the corner at radii 2, 3, 4 and more times 16 px, continuing the hinge diagram's ring and arcs (radii 110 and 165 units, 2 to 3), ending inside a quarter circle 219 px wide, 1 px in oa.color.border.hairline (Stone). Ink coverage measured on a 240 px swatch rendered at 1x in Chromium, as Phase 1 measured its patterns: 5.5 percent, under the 12 percent ceiling (D1-18). Round 3 (CA-S11): the hinge rules leave the rule, since sixteen even lines read as lines to write on, and the plate is the cover alone at 360 px, so no part of the frame stands empty and a phone shows it whole. The cover is a report's first screen, with type at the phone floor (D2-254).

s-12-pattern-failure.alt: Failure case: do not publish. The same Illustrative cover with the arcs spread over the whole of it, so the fine lines run behind the title and the paragraph.
s-12-pattern-failure.notes: The arcs under body text, the failure the brief names. The band runs the plate's width, as chapter 11's 360 px plates set it, and the Illustrative label opens the cover under it (CD-S11). Failure band per D2-308.

s-proofs-masthead.alt: The site masthead at true size: a 1440 pixel Newsprint bar with OATH & ACTION and the lockmark at left and five navigation words at right. Below it, on the same left edge, the 390 pixel phone bar with the wordmark and a menu button.
s-proofs-masthead.notes: Today's width (DR-115). L3 from its masthead master: the 24 px wordmark master (221 px), 13 px and the lockmark at 48 px from its 48 px master (DR-131); phone bar with the 24 px master (Rule 03.6). s-proofs-avatar.alt: Ampersand B alone, red on Charcoal, at true size: a 400 pixel square upload with a thin circle showing where a platform cuts it; the same avatar in a white feed at 48 and 32 pixels beside the name Oath & Action and the words Posted a link; and a 180 pixel Charcoal app icon with rounded corners.

s-proofs-social.alt: A social card at actual size, 1200 by 630 pixels, on Newsprint: the kicker Explainer · Zoning, its label in Charcoal and its topic in gray, the hinge headline The zoning code & the rent. broken before a red ampersand B, the wordmark 44 pixels tall at bottom left and the lockmark at 48 pixels at bottom right, inside the 72 pixel margin. No web address. Under it, the card’s specifications. The headline and kicker are invented.
s-proofs-social.notes: 1200 by 630, the link-preview size, type at the desktop ceiling (D2-254). The headline is chapter 02's hinge example. Round 3 (D2-973, CA-S18): the kicker moves from the H4 style at 24 px to the H3 style at 32 px, the largest step the type scale gives a 1200 px board below the section and title styles, so at 358 px wide in a phone's feed it stands 9.5 px, legible on a 2x screen, where 24 px gave 7.2 px; its label takes Charcoal and its topic Deep Stone, as Rule 01.21 sets a kicker's two parts. No pillar row or symbol (D2-962). Sign-off from the lockmark's 48 px master at 48 px (DR-131): since November 10, 2026 the rebuilt file, lockmark/20261109_Lockmark-48px-Master-Outline.svg, each node and the lever one outline (DR-181). The feed test (D2-468) ran again on this card in the built page with that master, and its figures are the ones printed here (work/handoffs/phase-2/20261110_Promotion-Identity-Figures.json, key feed). No web address until the site is settled (DR-55).

s-proofs-letterhead.alt: A US Letter letterhead at true size on screen, 8.5 by 11 inches: a line in the top margin saying the address, recipient and letter are invented; the wordmark at top left; a return address at top right; a records request to the town clerk of Wrenfield signed by Dustin Cathcart, Founder and Editor; and a footer with the lockmark at 24 pixels followed by the tagline. A link downloads the one-page print proof.

Display master at 26 px tall, as a print piece places it. Footer: the lockmark at 24 px, 12 px, then the tagline, at the footer's left edge, the footer place as Rule 08.2 now draws it (CA-S10). interactive: the stage holds the PDF link. The footer draws the rebuilt 24 px master in use since November 10, 2026, each node and the lever one outline (DR-181), on screen and in the print proof the link downloads, work/boards/phase-2/stage-a/proofs/20261110_Letterhead-Proof.pdf, printed November 10 (D2-809). The November 6 and 7 proofs stay beside it as the record.

At left in each pair, L2: OATH over ACTION with a large ampersand at the right of the second line. At right, S1: OATH & over ACTION on two flush-left lines, the ampersand at the size of the capitals. S1 runs about a fifth narrower than L2 at every size.
